messages.subject: better View function?
parts:
Hi,

I don't know how difficult it is to implement this, but what I find a bit frustrating in R is that it is not easy to visually explore datasets as in a spreadsheet.
The View function does the job but it really isn't great in my opinion. It would be nice to have a more user friendly data viewer in Tinn-R similar to the one in Rstudio that can be opened in a separate Window.

Thanks.

Giulio

Thanks again in advance.

Giulio
